title: Punjab Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1989

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1989
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VIII OF 1989
ACT VIII OF 1989
PUNJAB MINISTERS
(SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act further to
amend the Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 26th July, 1989]
No. Legis. 2(18)/89/58, dated
26-7-1989.--The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
(Amendment), Bill, 1989, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on the 6th day of July, 1989 and assented to by the Governor of the
Punjab on 22nd day of July, 1989, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Punjab Ministers (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force on
the first day of July, 1989.

An Act further to
amend the Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 26th July, 1989]
No. Legis. 2(18)/89/58, dated
26-7-1989.--The Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
(Amendment), Bill, 1989, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on the 6th day of July, 1989 and assented to by the Governor of the
Punjab on 22nd day of July, 1989, is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
2. Amendment of section 3 of
Act XLI of 1975: -In the Punjab Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975 (XLI of 1975), hereinafter referred to as the said Act,
in section 3, for the word "six" and the word "rive", the
word "eight" and the word "six" shall respectively be
substituted.
